Product Engineer Intern — AI Operator

Ever Tech · Sofia or remote from the EU

A paid 3–6 month internship working with AI agents under a senior engineer’s guidance.

Responsibilities

  • Use AI agents to work on fixes, tests and documentation for open-source projects.
  • Review changes proposed by agents and pair with a mentor.

Requirements

  • Show a completed project or contribution in a repository.
  • Know TypeScript or another typed language, Git, basic SQL and HTTP.
  • Have experience using an AI coding agent and be able to write project updates in English.

Conditions

  • Hybrid in Sofia or remote from the EU.
  • The employer provides a laptop, model budget and assigned mentor.
